positive.prompt: Review this pull request before I merge it
Do a quality pass on this diff for correctness and readability
Can you review the changes another model just wrote for me?
Review this diff before I merge it. It adds paging to the orders endpoint.

negative.prompt: Write a failing test for the bug before fixing it

evals.prompt: Review the provided diff that adds a user-search endpoint. Deliver a structured review.
evals.expected_output: A multi-axis review with severity-labelled findings and file:line references
expectations: Findings cover more than one axis (correctness, readability, architecture, security, performance)
Every finding carries a severity label from the skill's taxonomy
Security of user input is explicitly considered for the new endpoint
The review leads with high-leverage findings rather than nits

evals.prompt: Review the account cache proposal in brief.md. Deliver findings only.
evals.expected_output: A prioritized review identifying account-key collisions, cache-hit authorization bypass, query cost and missing verification without editing implementation.
expectations: Findings explain cross-account cache leakage using the documented identifier scope and cache-hit ordering
The unbounded limit and per-item repository work receive consequence-based review where supported
Each finding uses a severity, triggering condition and concrete remedy
The report distinguishes source-derived risk from executed exploit evidence and leaves implementation unchanged
